review_evidence: Unit-wide inventory covers 203 primary Foundation files spanning propositional/first-order logic, arithmetic, set theory, semantics, proof systems, forcing, completeness/incompleteness and metaprogrammed provers.
Declaration-light Basic/root files are import/public-import aggregation surfaces and are retained.
Foundation/Meta/Test.lean was inspected despite its name: it contains numerous substantive classical and intuitionistic entailment examples over the project proof systems, so it remains searchable.
summary: Reviewed FormalizedFormalLogic Foundation and retained all 203 primary files; test/import naming is not used as an exclusion signal where real formal statements or navigation are present.
